facts.business: L&T Technology Services Limited provides engineering and R&D services, integrating AI into intelligent products, autonomous processes, and next-gen manufacturing plants across multiple domains.
facts.related_party_note: Transactions with holding company Larsen & Toubro Limited include rent paid (Rs 390M), services availed (Rs 191M), services rendered (Rs 133M), trademark fees (Rs 294M), and dividend paid (Rs 4,367M). Transactions with fellow subsidiaries include LTM Limited, L&T Realty Developers Limited, and L&T Semiconductor Technologies Limited. Transactions with subsidiaries include L&T Technology Services LLC, Intelliswift Software Inc, Intelliswift Software (India) Private Limited, and L&T Thales Technology Services Private Limited.
